"
Strategy_Assembler.py  (v2.1)
==============================
Builds a per-ticker strategy ensemble from the Enricher's output and computes
the metrics used by Portfolio_Balancer.py to allocate across tickers.

HOW IT WORKS
------------
For each ticker in top3_global.csv:

  1. Retrieves the daily OOS returns for all its selected strategies.
  2. Deduplicates: drops strategies whose returns correlate > DEDUP_CORR with a
     higher-scoring strategy (cross-indicator redundancy filter).
  3. Combines the remaining strategies into a single return series using rolling
     inverse-vol weights (recalculated every REBAL_FREQ days, LOOKBACK window).
     Equal weights during warmup. No look-ahead: weights use only past data.
  4. Computes ensemble performance metrics (Sharpe, CAGR, MaxDD, Sortino,
     monthly_consistency, tail_ratio) and a held-out validation period (last
     VAL_DIAS trading days) with the same metrics.
  5. Computes diversification_score and ensemble_benefit_ratio so the Portfolio
     Balancer can down-weight fragile single-strategy ensembles.

DESIGN PRINCIPLE — Separation of Selection and Validation
---------------------------------------------------------
The Assembler SELECTS strategies (rolling weights based on historical Sharpe).
Validation is performed separately by validacion.py. Mixing the two would turn
the robustness test into another round of optimization (overfitting).

INPUTS
------
    top3_global.csv              — Enricher output: one row per strategy,
                                   columns: strategy_id, ticker, asset_group,
                                   indicator, params, side, selection_score
    oos_returns_long.*           — long-format daily returns (strategy_id × date)
    sleeve_map.json              — maps tickers to portfolio sleeves

OUTPUTS
-------
    ensemble_per_ticker.csv      — one row per ticker with all metrics
    ensemble_returns_long.*      — (ticker, date, return) assembled daily returns
    ensemble_equity_curves.*     — (ticker, date, equity) per-ticker equity curves
    assembler_report.txt         — human-readable summary

Run: py Strategy_Assembler.py
     Next step: py Portfolio_Balancer.py
"
